2029. Find Height of BST

90

Hard

Problem Statement

Create a Binary Search Tree and determine the height of the tree.

For this problem, the height is defined as the number of nodes in the longest path from the root to a leaf.

Input
First line contains N.
Second line contains N integers.
Output

Print the height of the BST.
